headline_marked: 3 [[Jubo Shakti leaders jailed]] over kidnapping and extortion in Dinajpur
headline: 3 Jubo Shakti leaders jailed over kidnapping and extortion in Dinajpur
summary: Police arrested the leaders after they allegedly kidnapped a man over a land dispute involving 4.5 lakh BDT.
details: Three central leaders of Jubo Shakti, an affiliate of the National Citizen Party (NCP), have been sent to jail after being accused of kidnapping and extortion in Dinajpur.

The police arrested Arif Mun, the central joint organizational secretary of Jubo Shakti, along with Hasin Israk and Azmir Hossain, after rescuing the victim, Abdus Samad, from the city's Gor-e-Shahid Bor Maath.
The victim's son filed a case with Kotwali Police Station, naming five individuals and 10 to 12 unidentified persons as suspects.

According to NCP leaders, the incident stemmed from a land dispute where the victim had allegedly failed to transfer ownership of land for which he had taken 4.5 lakh BDT from a relative of Azmir Hossain.
It is alleged that the suspects called Samad from his home on Sunday night and demanded the repayment of the money.
Police reports indicate that some NCP and Jubo Shakti activists attempted to forcibly release the detained leaders from the police station, leading to scuffles with officers.
Kotwali Police Station OC Nurnabi confirmed that the case involves a financial transaction dispute and that five suspects have been sent to court and subsequently jailed.

headline_marked: [[Local government elections in October]], schedule in late August
headline: Local government elections in October, schedule in late August
summary: Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman announced a roadmap to complete all local government elections within one year.
details: Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman announced that the schedule for local government elections will be released in the second half of August, with voting expected to take place in October.
Speaking at a weekly briefing at the Secretariat on Tuesday, he stated that a roadmap has been developed to ensure all types of local government elections are completed within the next year.
During the briefing, the advisor also shared that the government currently holds over 900,000 metric tons of food grains beyond the required buffer stock.
He further mentioned that the July Museum will be inaugurated before August 5, and a pilot project to encourage children to read books in schools will be launched through the World Literature Center.
Addressing a cocktail attack on an NCP rally, the advisor called the incident regrettable and assured that the government is investigating the matter to arrest the perpetrators.
He added that the remarks made by the NCP convener regarding the incident were largely political in nature.
caption:
Local government elections are coming. The schedule will be out in late August, with voting in October.

Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman announced that the schedule for local government elections will be released in the second half of August, with voting expected to take place in October.

Speaking at a weekly briefing at the Secretariat on Tuesday, he stated that a roadmap has been developed to ensure all types of local government elections are completed within the next year.

During the briefing, the advisor also shared that the government currently holds over 900,000 metric tons of food grains beyond the required buffer stock.

He further mentioned that the July Museum will be inaugurated before August 5, and a pilot project to encourage children to read books in schools will be launched through the World Literature Center.

Addressing a cocktail attack on an NCP rally, the advisor called the incident regrettable and assured that the government is investigating the matter to arrest the perpetrators.

He added that the remarks made by the NCP convener regarding the incident were largely political in nature.

#Bangladesh #LocalGovernment #Elections #Politics #Dhaka

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News
